events.title: Davis Creek, YT
events.thought: End of day fifty-six. Dempster Highway beckons.

events.title: Aurora Borealis, Dempster Highway
events.thought: The aurora came out dancing on the Dempster — Waldo had front row seats.
events.photoCaption: Waldo's rooftop tent silhouetted against a full aurora borealis display over the Dempster Highway, Yukon.

events.title: Waldo on the Dempster
events.thought: A tiny black speck on the Dempster — Waldo and the Yukon on equal terms.
events.photoCaption: Waldo navigates the Dempster Highway across fall tundra in full color, the Yukon's infinite ridgelines receding behind.

events.title: Chicken, Alaska
events.thought: Chicken, Alaska — the rooster and the signpost say it all.
events.photoCaption: The famous metal rooster and directional signpost in Chicken, Alaska, pointing to chicken-named places worldwide.

events.title: Dempster Ridgeline View
events.thought: Parked on the ridgeline with nothing between us and the horizon for a hundred miles.
events.photoCaption: Waldo on a Dempster ridgeline, vast fall-toned Yukon mountains stretching to every horizon under deep blue sky.
